build_clip_model: build a CLIP model from a name string with optional frozen parameters for open vocabulary segmentation
expand_box: expand a bounding box by a ratio and clamp coordinates to image dimensions
mask2box: convert a binary mask tensor into a bounding box with min and max coordinates
crop_with_mask: crop an image tensor using a mask and bounding box with configurable fill values
review_expand_box: review the expand_box function to understand bounding box expansion and clamping logic
